text:
devon: Heads-up — night canary for kernel v4.2-quant patch is scheduled now (00:30 UTC). Deploybot will roll 5% traffic to gpu-pool-eu.

deploybot: [automated] Start roll: kernel=4.2-quant build=2026.03.20-rc1 target=5% pools=[gpu-pool-eu] window=night

maya: saw CI noise in matmul microbench on A100-sxm, small latency tail bump on 512 tokens, filing link to perf job.

maya: https://ci.internal/runs/12345

sam: can you paste the perf diff? is it across all kernels or only the quant path?

maya: quick snippet:
```
mean_latency: +0.3ms
p99_latency: +18ms
p999_latency: +120ms
kernel_path: quant_matmul_v2
hardware: A100-sxm
```

liam: that's concerning for latency-sensitive routes. QA: any failed tests?

qa-bot: Integration tests passed. Stress harness flagged increased tail for batched-16 with seq>=512 on staging.

devon: ops, should we pause the rollout and pin production to kernel 4.1 for now?

opsbot: Suggestion: pause canary, snapshot telem, escalate to runtime-oncall. Would you like me to pause? :warning:

anna: yes pause. also create a rollback ticket and mark release notes draft 'hold'.

devon: deploybot, pause roll and pin pool gpu-pool-eu to kernel=4.1 until further notice.

deploybot: [automated] Pausing roll. Current canary traffic frozen at 5%. Applying pin: gpu-pool-eu -> kernel=4.1 (user-requested). Rolling back further traffic not automated.

liam: I'll grab traces, start bisect on quant matmul change set. Maya, can you attach the perf run config?

maya: sent run config to #eng-ml and uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/12345

devon: thanks. We'll reconvene in 30m with telemetry snapshot and rollback runbook. If p99 stays high after revert we escalate to infra.

sam: noted. updating release notes: 'Hold: quant kernel v4.2-quant — investigating latency regressions.'

opsbot: runtime-oncall paged: @liam @devon @maya

liam: on it, ping back in 20.
